scripts.build-latest: npm run _ensure-latest-xerakt && npm run _build && echo "finished building from the latest commit of the main branch of xerakt; built packages are in the ./packages/ folder;"
scripts.build-current-worktree: [ -d xerakt ] && npm run _build-current-worktree || echo "error: no ./xerakt/ folder; try cloning it with the clone-xerakt npm script;"
scripts.clone-xerakt: [ -d xerakt ] && echo "error: ./xerakt/ folder already exists, can't clone xerakt; if you think it is not what should be, you can delete it manually;" || npm run _clone-xerakt
scripts._build-current-worktree: npm run _build && echo "finished building from the current local worktree of xerakt in ./xerakt/ folder; built packages are in the ./packages/ folder;"
scripts._checkout-latest-xerakt: echo "important: ./xerakt/ folder did already exist; trying to fetch and checkout the latest commit; if something will go wrong, you can try manually deleting the ./xerakt/ folder and then trying again;" && git -C xerakt checkout main && git -C xerakt pull
scripts._clone-xerakt: git clone -b main https://github.com/xerakt/xerakt.git && echo "good: xerakt repo was cloned into ./xerakt/ folder; if build now, it will be from the latest commit of the main branch of xerakt;"
scripts.pre_build: dir=packages npm run __dangerous__ensure-no-dir && dir=tmp npm run __dangerous__ensure-no-dir
scripts.__dangerous__ensure-no-dir: [ -d $dir ] && dir=$dir npm run __dangerous__remove-dir || echo "good: ./$dir/ folder didn't exist;"
